# OpenModeration

> Your community, protected. Connect your Facebook Page, Instagram account, or YouTube channel in minutes. Your rules, enforced automatically by AI — every hidden comment comes with a written reason. No code required. Free to start, no credit card required.

OpenModeration protects social media pages and communities from hateful comments, spam, and scams. It is built for community managers, small businesses, media newsrooms, and creators — not just developers. Open source (AGPL v3), made and hosted in the EU, GDPR-compliant.

## Who it is for
- Community managers and social media teams drowning in toxic comments and spam
- Small businesses and brands whose comment sections hurt their image and sales
- Media newsrooms facing waves of hate under hot news on their social accounts
- Developers needing a moderation API (separate track, same platform)

## How it works
1. Connect your Facebook, Instagram, or YouTube account in a few clicks
2. Set your rules once: forbidden words, category thresholds, and your community charter in plain language (one-click `balanced` preset)
3. The AI hides what clearly breaks your rules; borderline cases go to your team's review queue (Approve / Reject in one click)
4. Every decision — AI or human — is logged with a written reason, ready for audits

## Key facts
- **Your rules**: plain-language charter, forbidden/suspect words, per-category thresholds, presets (light / balanced / strict), modes (auto / mixed / manual), per-source settings
- **Transparent**: written justification for every hidden comment, full AI + human audit log, open-source code, EU hosting
- **Easy to set up**: protected in about 5 minutes, no developer needed
- **Platforms**: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube (native connectors); any other content via REST API and webhooks
- **Pricing**: Free cloud plan (1,000 requests/month ≈ 30 comments/day); Pro at €99/month (10,000 requests/month ≈ 300 comments/day, managed keys, priority support & SLA); Enterprise custom (dedicated infrastructure, custom SLA); free unlimited self-hosting via Docker
- **Compliance**: DSA-ready audit trails and transparency reporting; GDPR-compliant EU hosting
- **Trust**: AGPL v3 open source, no vendor lock-in, bring your own provider keys (BYOK) optional

## For developers
REST API (`POST /v1/moderation`), multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Azure, Mistral, HuggingFace, Cohere, Hive, Perspective, LLM via OpenRouter), standardized scores across 10 categories, batch up to 10,000 items, webhooks, TypeScript-friendly. Docs: https://api.openmoderation.com/docs — Source: https://github.com/open-moderation/open-moderation

## License
AGPL v3. Fully auditable, no vendor lock-in. Self-host free, unlimited.
